mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months compresses discount rates for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS declines for three consecutive months, or the Rank IC falls below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 5.0% for two consecutive months, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 5.0% for two consecutive months, or the Rank IC is negative over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous high inflation (CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5%) and restrictive monetary policy (FEDFUNDS > 0.25%) compress equity valuations through higher discount rates and growth concerns, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: high inflation and tight policy regime
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5% and FEDFUNDS > 0.25%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In periods of declining industrial production (INDPRO < 100), manufacturing sector weakness reduces corporate earnings growth expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where INDPRO < 100, or the Rank IC is negative over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in non-farm payrolls above 100,000 persons signals strong labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods with PAYEMS growth above 100,000, or the Rank IC falls below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST > 1,200,000 units) and declining unemployment (UNRATE < 5.0%) indicates robust consumer demand and labor market strength, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where HOUST > 1200.0 and UNRATE < 5.0%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year CPI inflation rate exceeds 2.5%, it triggers expectations of monetary tightening that depress equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods with CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5%, or the Rank IC is negative over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In periods of high consumer spending (RSAFS > 450,000 million dollars), retail sales growth supports corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods with RSAFS > 450000.0, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
